answer: ArcelorMittal reported a total fatality frequency rate of 0.014 per million hours worked for 2025 versus 0.035 for 2024. It reported six fatalities in 2025, four involving contractors. The accompanying claim was that FFR fell by more than 50% year on year and reached its lowest rate.
